name: state-read-and-written-back
note: The second half of ABI §5.1's re-instantiation pair, and the point of a stateful block: the seed here is exactly what 15_state_from_nothing left behind, so this is the same block coming back with new memory and the same store. It continues rather than restarting. Also the unscripted read path — the value is short enough for the block's first buffer, so there is one state_get and ABI §8's retry never runs, which is the contrast 10_state_grow_and_retry needs to mean anything.
